vyraketh.sentence: When Vyraketh breathes, every Fire tile spreads 1 tile in all four directions.
vyraketh.at_half_health_sentence: After every second Vyraketh turn, every Fire tile spreads 1 tile in all four directions.

tharokh.sentence: After every second turn of yours, Tharokh's marked tiles rise as Outcrops.
tharokh.at_half_health_sentence: After each of your turns, Tharokh's marked tiles rise as Outcrops.

iskaldra.sentence: When Iskaldra uses Rime Talon, Frostbite hits everyone on Ice for 3 and Freezes them.
iskaldra.at_half_health_sentence: After every second Iskaldra turn, Frostbite hits everyone on Ice for 3 and Freezes them.

vaeloryx.sentence: After each Vaeloryx turn, its wind Pushes everyone 1 tile, then turns a quarter clockwise.
vaeloryx.at_half_health_sentence: After each Vaeloryx turn, its wind Pushes everyone 2 tiles, then turns a quarter clockwise.

zekarion.sentence: When Zekarion uses Overload, lightning strikes every Electrified tile for 5, with Chain 1.
zekarion.at_half_health_sentence: When Zekarion uses Overload, lightning strikes every Electrified tile for 5, with Chain 2.

noctyrax.sentence: When Noctyrax uses Void Claw, hidden Veilbound Acolytes Blink 3 tiles toward you.
